Title:
Junior QA
Location:
Blainville, QC (onsite as needed, approx 1x per quarter)
Duration
: 6 month contract
Pay range
: $39 - $47 per hour

Vacancy Status:

This posting is for a currently vacant role, and the successful candidate will be hired into an existing open position

JOB DESCRIPTION

We are seeking a Junior QA Analyst to support a large-scale digital transformation initiative within the waste management industry. This role will focus primarily on manual testing of enterprise applications that support operations such as route management, customer service, billing, fleet operations, work orders, recycling programs, and landfill management. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, eager to learn, and passionate about ensuring software quality through thorough testing and defect identification. This is an excellent opportunity to gain experience working on complex enterprise systems in an Agile environment

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

- Bilingual French & English
- 2+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, Software Testing, or a related field.
- Hands on experience with functional testing of new screens and reports
- Focus/specialization with Manual testing
- Experience supporting application releases
- Experience with Playwright
- Ability to work independently in Agile project environments

NICE TO HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

• Automated testing exposure
• Node.js knowledge
• Git experience

Artificial intelligence tools are used to assist with screening and assessing applicants for this position.

jobs.title: Junior Security Analyst
jobs.description:
Interested in telecoms security and keen to build your career in a fast-moving, global environment? We are looking for a Threat Intelligence Analyst to join our Threat Intelligence team in Toronto, reporting to the Head of Threat Intelligence and working closely with experienced analysts across our global team. This is an opportunity to develop your technical and client-facing skills while helping us identify and respond to evolving threats across the telecoms landscape.

Role And Key Responsibilities

Based in Toronto, you will analyse customer deployment data, investigate emerging threats and help maintain security solutions on Enea client platforms. You will take ownership of client questions and security reviews, working independently while supported by regional and global colleagues. Some scheduled Saturday or Sunday shift coverage will form part of the role.

Key responsibilities include:

Create, configure and maintain security solutions on Enea client platforms.
Monitor the telecoms threat landscape and keep your knowledge of relevant security developments current.
Analyse data collected from customer deployments to identify, investigate and document potential threats.
Deliver security reviews for Enea clients, respond independently to client questions and manage expectations.
Communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including where commercial considerations are relevant.
Work independently on assigned activities while collaborating with regional and global Threat Intelligence colleagues.
Participate in agreed shift coverage, including some Saturday or Sunday work.

Required Qualifications

Qualifications, Key Skills and Competence

BSc degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications or a related technical field.
A strong interest in telecoms and security technology, with curiosity about an evolving threat landscape.
Working knowledge of Unix/Linux environments and basic familiarity with SQL and database concepts.
Knowledge of TCP/IP, HTTP, SMTP and DNS, together with an understanding of GSM network fundamentals.
Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to explain concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
Availability to participate in scheduled weekend shift coverage as required.

Preferred Qualifications

1-3 years of relevant experience in telecoms, cybersecurity, threat intelligence, network or security analysis, or a related technical environment.
Experience with messaging systems and architectures.
Knowledge of shell scripting or a scripting language such as Python, Ruby or Perl.
Experience analysing customer or operational data, investigating security issues or contributing to security reviews.
Experience working in a global, client-facing or fast-moving technical environment.

What can Enea offer you?

At Enea, we strive to create an environment where you can thrive both professionally and personally. We offer:

Flexible hybrid work: A modern work model that supports a healthy work-life balance.
Collaborative environment: A dynamic, globally connected team culture that fosters engagement in cybersecurity initiatives and cross-regional projects.
Inclusive culture: A diverse and inclusive workplace that values your voice and promotes mutual respect and collaboration.
Competitive compensation: A competitive salary package complemented by region-specific benefits.
Ongoing learning and career development: Continuous learning opportunities and clearly defined career paths to support your professional growth across the organization.

About The Threat Intelligence Team

Enea's Threat Intelligence team supports telecom operators in understanding and responding to evolving security threats by combining customer deployment data, analyst expertise and Enea security technology. Our global analysts work closely with customers and colleagues across the business to investigate suspicious activity, identify emerging patterns and strengthen the security services delivered through Enea's platforms.

Does this sound exciting? We would love to learn more about you! Apply today. We review applications on an ongoing basis and may fill the position before the final deadline.

About Enea

Enea is a global specialist in advanced telecom and cybersecurity software, with a vision to make the world's communication safer and more efficient. Through continuous innovation, Enea's solutions help secure, optimize, and monetize communication services. The company serves over 300 customers in more than 100 countries, including telecom operators, communication platform providers, cybersecurity vendors, and government organizations. Every day, more than 3 billion people rely on Enea software for seamless connectivity between people, businesses, and connected devices. Enea is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden, and the company is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm.

To learn more, visit www.enea.com

jobs.title: Technical Writer
jobs.description:
About Us:

ZenaTech (Nasdaq: ZENA | FSE: 49Q) is a technology company specializing in AI drones, Drone-as-a-Service (DaaS), enterprise SaaS, and quantum computing solutions for mission-critical business applications. Since 2017, the company has leveraged its software development expertise and expanded its drone design and manufacturing capabilities through ZenaDrone to innovate and enhance customer inspection, monitoring, safety, security, compliance, and surveying processes.

Job Overview:

We are seeking a detail‑oriented and highly organized Technical Writer to create clear, concise, and accurate documentation for our products, processes, and internal teams. The ideal candidate excels at translating complex technical concepts into user‑friendly content and collaborates closely with cross‑functional stakeholders, including engineering, product management, and support.

Key Responsibilities:

Develop high‑quality documentation, including user guides, API references, release notes, FAQs, knowledge base articles, and process documentation.
Translate complex technical information into clear, engaging, and accessible content for various audiences.
Collaborate with subject matter experts (SMEs) across engineering, product, QA, and customer support to gather information and validate accuracy.
Maintain and update existing documentation to ensure relevance, accuracy, and consistency.
Standardize content by adhering to style guides, templates, and formatting best practices.
Create visual aids (diagrams, flowcharts, screenshots, tables) to support written content.
Participate in product testing to better understand functionality and identify documentation needs.
Manage documentation workflows, version control, and content repositories (e.g., Confluence, Git, SharePoint).
Ensure accessibility and usability by writing with clarity, structure, and user experience in mind.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Technical Writing, Communications, English, Computer Science, or a related field.
2–4+ years of experience as a Technical Writer or similar role.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong ability to understand and explain technical concepts.
Experience creating documentation for software, systems, or technical processes.
Proficiency with documentation tools such as: Confluence, Notion, SharePoint, Markdown, HTML, Git/GitHub, Adobe Acrobat, Snagit, or similar tools
Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and meet deadlines.
Experience with API documentation tools (e.g., Swagger/OpenAPI).
Familiarity with UX writing principles.
Knowledge of structured authoring frameworks (e.g., DITA).
Experience working in Agile development environments.
Strong attention to detail
Analytical thinking
Curiosity and problem‑solving mindset
Collaboration and cross‑functional communication
Ability to simplify complexity

Artificial Intelligence:

We use artificial intelligence to review and screen applications and materials. However, every candidate we move forward with is reviewed and selected, and all final hiring decisions are made by a member of our hiring team.

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to employment equity utilizing hiring practices on merit and business needs. We encourage applications from women, Indigenous peoples, persons with disabilities, members of visible minorities and all others of legally protected status.

This job post is for an existing vacancy.
